messages:
olivia: Alert — eu-west1 embeddings p999 exploded after canary shift to quant-lite-2. Multiple customer timeouts. Need an immediate mitigation.
noah: ugh. logs show higher decode latency, not infra. no CPU/ooms.
olivia: confirmed. short-context-heavy requests hit the tail. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/eu/embeds/shot
noah: proposal: temporary routing swap to fallback model (quant-stable) for eu-west1 alias. That avoids rolling pods.
infra-sig: routing switch is safest. minimal cache churn. ops impact <1% errors for ~30s.
olivia: approvals needed to skip canary: ENG x2 + SRE. noah you good to +1?
noah: +1.
sre-oncall: SRE signoff: OK to proceed, will monitor error budget.
olivia: deploybot show command and estimated propagation please.
deploybot: auto: suggested command: 
```
/deploybot pin-model --alias eu-embed-default --model quant-stable --region eu-west1 --force --reason "hotfix: quant-lite-2 tail latency regression"
```
Estimated propagation: 15-25s. Expected transient 5xx <1%.
noah: leaving release-note stub: "eu embeddings: emergency revert to quant-stable after quant-lite-2 tail latency regression". PR to follow.
olivia: running it now.
deploybot: queued by olivia. approvals satisfied (eng:2, sre:1). executing...
deploybot: done: alias eu-embed-default -> quant-stable (eu-west1). change_id: ch_3654321999_pin. propagated in 17s.
sre-oncall: metrics look good at 1m: p99 back to baseline, p999 falling. no error surge.
noah: nice. I'll open an issue for ml perf triage and pause further canaries for quant-lite-2 until there's a perf sign-off.
olivia: PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/943 (draft). I'll monitor for 30m then close thread.
infra-sig: scheduling postmortem with eng-ml + infra tomorrow 10:00 UTC. invite sent.
noah: thanks everyone. closing after 30m stable.
olivia: thanks — keeping eyes on it :eyes:
